failed_step: Verify reviewed ZIP and refuse existing tag or release
diagnosis: Both expected absent-resource probes leave gh LASTEXITCODE=1. GitHub appends an exit using LASTEXITCODE to pwsh scripts; successful Set-Content does not replace that native exit code.
fix: Exit 0 only after package/preview verification, both confirmed HTTP 404 absence checks, and checksum write. All existing-tag, API-error and hash failures still abort before that point.
